location_exception_reason: Tensile structures are permanent/semi-permanent architectural systems with standardised design and installation methodology; location is a project attribute, not a product differentiator. Buyers search by application type (car parking, canopy, sports court) and membrane material, not geography.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Contractor, Installer, Fabricator) describe the seller's role in the design-fabricate-install chain, not the product itself. IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this distinction; removing these words leaves the product title complete and accurate.
